Authors and Citation

Authors

  • Rodrigo Pires. Author, maintainer.

  • Anna Hepworth. Author.

  • Rebecca O'Leary. Author.

  • Jonathan Carroll. Author.

  • James Goldie. Author.

  • Dean Marchiori. Author.

  • Paul Melloy. Author.

  • Mark Padgham. Author.

  • Hugh Parsonage. Author.

  • Keith Pembleton. Contributor.
    Contributed code and ideas for original bomrang package that was used in the creation of weatherOz.

  • Maëlle Salmon. Contributor.
    Contributed to debugging a nasty little bug with CI where timezones caused tests to fail due to vcr not recognising the URL when run outside of Australia-Perth TZ! Suggested the use of local_timzeone().

  • Max Moldovan. Contributor.
    Contributed valuable feedback on package usage leading to improvements in the package structure and functionality.

  • Stephen Bradshaw. Contributor.
    Identified data structure issues and provided insights that improved package data quality and usability.

  • Jimmy Ng. Contributor.

  • Steve Collins. Contributor.
    Designed the hex logo for 'weatherOz' hex logo.

  • Adam H. Sparks. Author.

  • Laurens Geffert. Reviewer.

  • Sam Rogers. Reviewer.

  • Western Australia Agriculture Authority (WAAA). Copyright holder.

  • Curtin University. Copyright holder.
